name: Northern Pass Watchtower
title: Northern Pass Watchtower
summary: A 31 m five-storey spire watchtower on a nearly inaccessible pinnacle plateau (z 298) in the northern Osteth mountains, 52.0N 3.1E. The plateau is about 60 m across, with pines, a Life Stone 26 m north of the tower and the wooden archway of the Destroyed Portal to Cragstone 44 m north-west. The rock falls 100-150 m on every side, to z 150-200 within 100 m.

site.name: Northern Pass Watchtower
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer life-stone-at-52-1n-3-1e (the plateau's Life Stone, 26 m north of the tower, z 298); a Life Stone has no collision effect.

shots.standingOrder: Hang 150 m east of the pinnacle over the valley, 22 m above its summit, and drift slowly while easing in on the watchtower on its rock, the morning sun behind the lens.
shots.notes: Establishing view. The camera hangs 150 m east of the pinnacle, 22 m above its summit and 200 m above the valley floor. It drifts 10 deg and eases 8 % closer while the lone tower and the Life Stone glow on top of a rock that falls away on every side. The sun is behind the lens. shots.notes: Dronie reveal. It starts 8 m from the Life Stone, 4 m up, then climbs back over the eastern cliff to 44 m above the plateau and 62 m out.
